name: Geseke (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Geseke (a white cross with a red wheel on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Geseke; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Geseke arms — cross with wheel on blue
